description: Read individual reviews of a Metacritic entry, from critics or from users. Get the slug and kind from search_titles first. Filter with 'sentiment' to read only what praised or panned it, which Metacritic groups itself. Metacritic returns a fixed sample rather than the full list, so 'total_available' is usually far larger than what comes back, and there is no way to page past the sample. Critic reviews carry the publication and a link to the original article: quote them with both. Critic scores run to 100 and user scores to 10, so do not average the two together.

kind.description: Which catalogue the entry belongs to. Pass it back with the slug.

limit.description: How many reviews to return from the sample Metacritic publishes.

offset.description: How many of the sampled reviews to skip. The sample itself cannot be paged past.

sentiment.description: Which slice to read. Metacritic groups reviews this way itself.

source.description: 'critic' is the professional press, 'user' is the audience.

name: get_reviews

next_offset.description: Pass as 'offset' for the next page.

max.description: Scale for this review's score: 100 for critics, 10 for users.

publication.description: Who ran it. Name it when quoting.

quote.description: Excerpt as published, truncated if long.

url.description: Original article. Link it when quoting.

source_url.description: Metacritic page these reviews belong to. Cite it when an article link is missing.
